verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Retell has API reference doc pages (e.g., api-references/clone-voice.md) and SDKs/CLI/MCP tooling, but no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (e.g., embedded 'try it' console or Swagger UI). The probe explicitly found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec exposed (all candidate paths 404), undermining any claim of an interactive reference.
